items: Start here: JGC Geoinformation (Greece) is chasing its pending FARO listings. On 5 Oct they wrote that 2 of their 4 listings, both FARO, have been pending since last week (#3230/#3231/#3235, listing request #2548 Focus Premium 70, a duplicate of #2547). They're a repeat seller and service-centre candidate. Approve one and answer them today, before they take the stock elsewhere.

New seller Ultimated (Samir Boufarit, Belgium), #3435, created this run and owned by you: 6 Topcon HiPer SR/VR kit listings arrived on 6 Oct (5 are live, $2,230–7,135), and he asked for consignment on #2556. Agree the consignment terms, merge the duplicates (#2558/#2561), and point Georges' HiPer VR buyer (#3148) at #2557.

Technoserv (Dubai), 2× RS4, paid AED 22,136: shipped via DPEX 218518086161 (waybill 5 Oct). Put the number in Tracking Reference on FMCGL/OUT/00034, and confirm delivery with Sonia.
Trimble TX8: 1 in stock, two buyers (#2928 Marco Bartolacci, #2919 Italy). Georges also has a TX8 buyer, Mike (#3286). Quote Marco today and agree with Georges who gets the unit.

● eBay: couldn't pull today, showing the last available data (5 Oct): 25 active listings, 11 offers eligible to send, 109 messages, 1 order in 90 days. Send the 11 offers. Also confirm the Mexico X7 (DHL 4345524013, ETA 5 Oct) was delivered.

eBay stock gap (in Odoo stock, not listed on eBay as of 5 Oct): 4× iCR80 5" R1000, 2× TM50 1", TM60 1", 2× TS60 I 0.5", 2× TS15 P 1" R400, TS11 1", 2× TS07 5", Faro S70/S120, DNA03, Topcon MS ×5, 6 Pro3 Performance Kits and the Emlid range. List the iCR80, TM50 and TS15 first.
